Gap:
Multi-factor authentication is not enforced on 3 administrator 
accounts
Risk detail:
These accounts can reach all customer payroll and benefits 
records with a password alone. A single stolen password could
 expose regulated personal data.
Effort: Low: enforce MFA on the 3 accounts

Gap: Backup restores have never been tested
Risk detail:
Backups run daily but no one has confirmed they can actually be
restored. A failed restore during an outage could lose customer 
data.
Effort: Medium: run and document restore tests

Gap: Logs are not aggregated or monitored
Risk detail:
The platform and identity provider generate logs, but nothing
collects or reviews them, so a breach could go undetected.
Effort: Medium: stand up log aggregation and a monitoring routine

Gap: No vendor risk management for the hosting provider
Risk detail:
Skypea depends entirely on CloudScale and has no supplier
inventory or due-diligence process for its most critical dependency.
Effort: Medium: build a supplier inventory and due-diligence review
